project.name: rawgentic-memorypalace
project.description: Claude Code plugin providing long-term memory powered by MemPalace with intelligent ingestion triggers, semantic search, and wake-up context

publishStrategy.syncMethod: .github/workflows/mirror-to-stars.yml — a GitHub Action that pushes main to the private mirror on every push to main, using the STARS_PAT repo secret
publishStrategy.note: Public repo is community-facing canonical. Private mirror lives in STARSAirAmbulance org because that's where the Claude org plugin marketplace installs from. Mirroring is done ONLY by the mirror-to-stars.yml Action; no dual-push remote is configured, and none should be. Verify a sync by reading that Action's run conclusion and comparing the two main shas — NEVER by a local push. A local push that reaches the STARS URL is misconfiguration, and its 'Repository not found' has caused two false 'the mirror is broken' diagnoses (issue #76, closed as invalid; issue #78). The 3D-Stories PAT (~/.secrets/github-pat) is required for the public repo; ~/.secrets/github_pat_stars is a human's credential for the mirror, not something any sync path uses.
